title: Navimower 0.4.5-beta25

## Reduce prepared live-route churn and add a short-tail transport contract

Map Card 0.3.7-beta12 field diagnostics confirmed that the prepared live-route
backend is working, but also showed that the integration was rebuilding the
prepared SVG backbone almost exactly at the previous 2-second minimum interval.
That is unnecessary once the frontend keeps the newest mower movement as a
small live/MQTT tail after the prepared backbone.

Beta25 changes the active prepared live-route cadence from 2 seconds to 30
seconds while preserving immediate publication for lifecycle changes.

- Normal active route growth is coalesced behind a 30-second minimum prepared
  backbone interval.
- Trail session, activity, physical-zone and trail-active transitions publish
  immediately instead of waiting for the next periodic refresh.
- Static prepared geometry remains unchanged and event-driven.
- The latest two content-addressed live resources are still retained for safe
  in-flight fetches.

## Prepared short-tail Map API

This beta prepares the backend contract for the next Map Card optimization
without breaking current cards.

Normal Map API responses continue to contain the existing full `trail` and
`trail_segments` fields.

New opt-in modes are available:

- `prepared_live_tail=1` adds a `prepared_live_tail` object describing only
  route points added after the latest retained prepared live resource.
- `prepared_live_tail_only=1` additionally removes full raw `trail` and
  `trail_segments` when the backend can prove that the short tail is aligned
  with the prepared resource.

The short tail:

- carries the prepared `base_resource_id` it extends;
- keeps the current `trail_session`;
- reports base/current/tail point counts;
- includes one overlap point per changed segment so the frontend can connect
  the live tail directly to the prepared SVG path;
- is bounded to 128 points.

Safety remains fallback-first. If the prepared resource is unavailable, the
trail session changed, the route rewound, or the short tail exceeds the safety
limit, `prepared_live_tail_only=1` keeps the full raw trail instead of
returning an incomplete route.

## Diagnostics

Prepared Render Model diagnostics now also expose:

- first/last manifest read age;
- first/last static and live resource read age;
- actual static/live resource body bytes served;
- 304/not-modified response counts;
- short-tail request, success and full-fallback counts;
- configured short-tail maximum;
- maximum observed short-tail point count;
- latest base/current/tail point counts and fallback reason.

The prepared discovery/manifest also advertises the 30-second live-route
minimum interval and short-tail capability so a future Map Card can align its
manifest polling cadence with the backend.

## Compatibility

Map Card 0.3.7-beta12 remains compatible and continues to use the existing full
raw trail as its browser-side live-tail source. The new short-tail-only transport
is opt-in and is intended for the next frontend beta.

Current-cycle artifacts, History/session archives, ZoneLedger, coverage,
Schedule semantics, gate logic and MQTT mower-position updates are unchanged.
